description: Set which weekdays the human prefers (their showings rank ahead of other days at the theatre's business day; null or all seven means no preference), the start-time window (24-hour HH:MM on each theatre's own clock, overnight allowed; null for any start; showings outside it are left out) and the second-film latest finish (theatre-local HH:MM; null for none). Only fields you pass change. A window saved earlier stays on Eastern Time until its times are changed. Preferred days reorder showings, they never hide one. Ask the human; never assume days or times. Never books or touches tickets.
name: set_schedule_preferences
title: Set preferred days and start times
